content.text:
**Finding: compliant (fallback level) — no redline proposed.**

IBM's § 8.1 delivers a genuine vendor-side IP indemnity: defence and indemnity of Bluefly *and its Enterprise* against third-party patent/trademark/copyright/trade-secret claims relating to IBM-provided Materials or Base Components, with the customary exclusions (Customer-provided items, Customer modifications, combinations with non-IBM products) and the full procure/modify/replace/refund remedy ladder. The super-cap element is over-satisfied: § 9.1(a) places indemnification payments outside IBM's $100,000 / twelve-month damages cap, so the indemnity is uncapped rather than capped at 3× annual fees.

Preferred-only gaps were noted in the rationale rather than redlined: no cover for IBM's breach of law, IBM-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct; refund credit limited to twelve months of charges; prompt notice framed as a strict condition; and our § 8.2(a)3 indemnity for Services Recipient claims "related, directly or indirectly, to the Services" is broader than Customer content/breach of law (mitigated by the § 8.2(c) fault carve-back). Since the clause meets every fallback element on its material terms, the playbook directs acceptance rather than an upgrade to preferred wording.
